name: Utsukushiki Elf
source:
After his doctor tells him he has only six months to live due to an incurable disease, a young human man named Matthias ventures into the untamed forest of Croft to investigate the elves, a race said to live for ages.

Deep within the forest, he meets a beautiful elf woman named Lydi, gradually becoming drawn to her and eventually falls in love with her.

But Matthias didn't have much time left.


"I used to hate you so much...! And yet...!"

"It seems I've come to like you."


A love story between a human and an elf—a tale of two different races.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/12834]Novelgame[/url]]
translation:
在他的医生告诉他，由于一种不治之症，他只剩下六个月的生命后，一位名叫马蒂亚斯的年轻人类男子冒险进入克罗夫特的未开垦森林去调查精灵，据说这个种族可以活很长时间。

在森林深处，他遇到了美丽的精灵女子莉迪，逐渐被她吸引，并最终爱上了她。

但马蒂亚斯已经没有多少时间了。


“我曾经非常讨厌你……！但是……！”

“看来我已经喜欢上你了。”


人类与精灵之间的爱情故事——两个不同种族的故事。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/12834]Novelgame[/url]]
